findings.explanation: Wireless presence and dwell time are not login events; the Authentication model describes authentication attempts, so nothing in this feed maps to it. dataModelAcceleration ('Enable for Authentication') repeats the mistake.
findings.suggested_fix: Use an empty cimModels list, or a model that fits presence events if one is identified.

findings.explanation: The catalog lists Splunkbase 1352 as 'App for Cisco Network Data' (cisco_ios), not a Cisco Security add-on, and it is unrelated to Cisco Spaces.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace with the Spaces Add-On for Splunk (8485), which is already referenced, or remove this entry.

findings.explanation: These are engagement labels (High, Medium, Low, Pass-through), not alert conditions; the SPL is a ranking report and nothing alerts.
findings.suggested_fix: Describe the search as a per-zone dwell summary with an engagement label.

findings.explanation: The SPL keeps all dwell_min > 0 and labels short dwell 'Pass-through' instead of filtering; no search sequences location updates, so the Sankey movement-flow visualization has no data.
findings.quote: Filter out devices with dwell times under 2 minutes to exclude pass-throughs. Build movement flow analysis by sequencing location updates per device MAC.
findings.suggested_fix: Align the text with the SPL, or add a movement-flow search; drop the Sankey otherwise.

findings.explanation: Event timing and the exitTime/entryTime field names used by the SPL are not confirmed; Cisco Spaces presence events may use different field names and timestamp formats, which would break the epoch subtraction.
findings.quote: Device presence events fire at entry, after 10 minutes of inactivity, and at exit.
findings.suggested_fix: Check a real DEVICE_PRESENCE event for the field names and formats.

findings.explanation: Validation step is copied from an access-control use case; the text also wanders into retail and healthcare, and says nothing about the privacy of tracking device MAC addresses.
findings.quote: Compare with the badge reader and access control system for the same doors, events, and time range.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate against the Cisco Spaces dashboard and add a privacy note for MAC-level tracking.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: tstats on Authentication.Authentication by user, action, src has no relation to dwell time or zone presence.
'Movement Flow Analysis' is not delivered by the SPL, which only summarizes dwell time per zone.

summary: A dwell-time report mapped to the Authentication data model, with a reference to the wrong Splunkbase app, and prose that describes movement-flow and thresholds the SPL does not implement.
